stories.headline: Anduril Raises $5B Series H at $61B Valuation, Doubling From a Year Ago

key_facts.fact: Anduril announced a $5 billion Series H led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz, valuing the defense-tech company at $61 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Anduril: funding brings valuation to $61 billion; round led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz — Reuters, published 2026-05-13.

key_facts.fact: The $61B valuation is double the $30.5B mark from Anduril's June 2025 Series G, bringing total funding to about $6.82 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Anduril raised a $5B Series H led by Thrive and a16z at a $61B valuation, up from $30.5B in June 2025, taking its total funding to $6.82B, and may IPO in 2027.

key_facts.fact: The company, which makes AI-backed weapons, is now considering an IPO in 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: The start-up, which makes A.I.-backed weapons, was valued at $61 billion in the financing round, double what it was a year ago.

key_facts.fact: Lux Capital and Founders Fund were expected to participate alongside the round's leads, per prior reporting on the deal.
key_facts.excerpt: Palmer Luckey's defense-tech company is in the middle of a multibillion-dollar funding round led by Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz... Lux Capital and Founders Fund are also expected to participate.

stories.headline: Isomorphic Labs Raises $2.1B Series B Led by Thrive to Scale AI Drug Design

key_facts.fact: Isomorphic Labs, a DeepMind spinout, raised $2.1 billion in a Series B led by Thrive Capital, with Alphabet, GV, MGX, Temasek, CapitalG, and the UK Sovereign AI Fund participating.
key_facts.excerpt: May 12, 2026 — Isomorphic Labs announces it has raised $2.1 Billion in Series B funding. The financing round is led by Thrive Capital... The round also includes participation from existing backers Alphabet and GV alongside new investors MGX, Temasek, CapitalG, and the UK Sovereign AI Fund.

key_facts.fact: The new capital brings Isomorphic Labs' total external funding to roughly $2.7 billion across two rounds, both led by Thrive Capital.
key_facts.excerpt: The Series B brings Isomorphic Labs' total external capital raised to approximately USD 2.7 billion across two rounds, both led by Thrive Capital.

key_facts.fact: CEO Demis Hassabis said the capital will scale the company's IsoDDE drug design engine and pipeline; the firm now expects first clinical trials by end of 2026, a delay from his earlier 2025 target.
key_facts.excerpt: 'This capital injection allows us to build out our drug design engine at scale, driving us forward in our mission to solve all diseases,' said founder and CEO Demis Hassabis... The company now expects its first clinical trials by the end of 2026 — a delay from the CEO's earlier target of having AI-designed drugs in trials by the end of 2025.

key_facts.fact: Isomorphic Labs was founded in 2021 as a DeepMind spinout, building on AlphaFold; it previously signed drug discovery deals worth up to $3 billion with Eli Lilly and Novartis.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2021 as a spin-off from Google DeepMind... The latest funding round comes a year after Isomorphic Labs raised $600 million in its first outside funding round. The startup drew wider attention in 2024 after signing drug discovery partnerships worth up to $3 billion with pharmaceutical giants Eli Lilly and Novartis.

stories.headline: SoftBank Q4 Net Profit Triples to $11.6B as OpenAI Stake Gains Hit $45B

key_facts.fact: SoftBank Group's Q4 (Jan–Mar 2026) net profit attributable jumped to 1.829 trillion yen ($11.61B) from 517.18B yen a year ago, well above Bloomberg estimates of 295.2B yen.
key_facts.excerpt: Softbank's net profit attributable in the three months to March 31 jumped to 1.829 trillion yen ($11.61 billion) from 517.18 billion yen a year ago... The print was well above Bloomberg estimates for a 295.2 billion yen profit.

key_facts.fact: The result was driven by a 3.043 trillion yen gain on investments during the quarter, with the bulk from the Vision Funds.
key_facts.excerpt: This was driven chiefly by an outsized 3.043 trillion yen gain on the company's investments during the quarter, a bulk of which came from its flagship Vision Funds.

key_facts.fact: SoftBank's OpenAI stake was valued at $79.6 billion as of end-March, representing a cumulative gain of $45 billion on the initial investment.
key_facts.excerpt: The value of Softbank's investment in AI startup OpenAI stood at $79.6 billion as of end-March, the company said, representing a cumulative gain of $45 billion on its initial investment.

key_facts.fact: SoftBank still has $17.5 billion outstanding on a $40 billion bridge loan taken to fund its OpenAI commitments; cumulative invested capital is $34.6 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: The company still has an outstanding balance of $17.5 billion on a $40 billion bridge loan taken to fund its investments in OpenAI... It has so far invested a cumulative $34.6 billion in the AI start-up.

key_facts.fact: SoftBank previously committed a further $30 billion in OpenAI in three $10B tranches through October 2026, which will bring its cumulative OpenAI investment to $64.6B and ownership to ~13%.
key_facts.excerpt: SBG... entered into a definitive agreement with OpenAI... to make follow-on investments of USD 30.0 billion via SoftBank Vision Fund 2... Upon completion of the Follow-on Investment, SBG's cumulative investment in OpenAI is expected to total USD 64.6 billion, representing an ownership interest of approximately 13%.

stories.headline: Alibaba Q4 Revenue Up 3% to $35.3B, Cloud Up 38% as AI Spend Pressures Margins

key_facts.fact: Alibaba reported quarterly revenue of RMB243.38 billion ($35.28B) for the three months ended March 31, 2026, up 3% year-over-year from RMB236.45B; on a like-for-like basis (excluding divested Sun Art and Intime), revenue would have grown 11%.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 was RMB243,380 million (US$35,283 million), an increase of 3% year-over-year compared to RMB236,454 million in the same quarter of 2025. Excluding revenue from the disposed businesses of Sun Art and Intime, revenue on a like-for-like basis would have grown by 11% year-over-year.

key_facts.fact: Cloud Intelligence Group revenue rose 38% YoY to RMB41.63 billion ($6.04B), the headline AI-driven growth line.

key_facts.fact: Quick commerce revenue jumped 57% to RMB19.99 billion as Alibaba leans into 'Taobao Instant Commerce' and Ele.me.

stories.headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Reverses, Joins Trump on China Trip After 11th-Hour Invite

key_facts.fact: Nvidia confirmed CEO Jensen Huang would visit Beijing with Trump after the U.S. president personally called him; Huang flew to Alaska to board Air Force One during a refueling stop.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia confirmed to CNBC that CEO Jensen Huang will visit China this week... After seeing the media coverage of Huang's absence from the delegation, Trump called the Nvidia executive and asked him to join, a source familiar with the situation told CNBC. Huang flew to Alaska to board Air Force One, the source said.

key_facts.fact: The reversal followed reports that Huang had been left off the original White House delegation list of 17 executives released Monday, a smaller group than the 27 who joined Trump's 2017 China trip.
key_facts.excerpt: Seventeen American CEOs were on a list of invited business delegates released by the White House on Monday – a smaller group than Trump's previous China trip in 2017, when 27 high-profile executives joined. Huang was not included on Monday's list, which fuelled speculation Washington had limited appetite for rolling back some of its tech export controls.

key_facts.fact: Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk also traveled on Air Force One; Trump is scheduled to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday and Friday.
key_facts.excerpt: The White House confirmed that Huang had boarded Air Force One during a refuelling stop in Anchorage, Alaska. It added that Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk was also travelling on the presidential plane.

key_facts.fact: Huang's addition revived hopes of progress on Nvidia's stalled sale of H200 AI chips in China; Washington currently lets Nvidia sell the H200 with a 25% revenue surcharge to the U.S. Treasury, with more advanced chips still restricted.
key_facts.excerpt: Huang's last-minute addition to the US delegation comes as Nvidia struggles to export its chips to China. Washington has allowed the firm to sell its H200 graphics processing unit in China as long as a 25 per cent revenue surcharge flows to the US Treasury, but the firm's more advanced models remain restricted.

key_facts.fact: Huang has previously pegged the China AI chip market at $50 billion and told CNBC last week it 'would be a privilege' to accompany Trump.
key_facts.excerpt: Huang, who's pegged China's market for AI chips at $50 billion, told CNBC last week that 'it would be a privilege' to accompany Trump on the trip.

stories.headline: Recursive Superintelligence Raises $650M+ at $4B to Build Self-Improving AI

key_facts.fact: Recursive Superintelligence has raised over $650 million from investors including GV, Greycroft, Nvidia, and AMD at a $4 billion valuation, per the New York Times.
key_facts.excerpt: Recursive Superintelligence, founded by former Google, Meta and OpenAI researchers, is part of a growing effort to automate the creation of artificial intelligence. The company has raised over $650 million from venture capital firms including Google Ventures and Greycroft and the chip-making giants Nvidia and AMD.

key_facts.fact: The London-incorporated startup is four months old and has roughly 20 employees; co-founders include Richard Socher (ex-Salesforce chief scientist, You.com CEO), Tim Rocktäschel (UCL professor, ex-DeepMind), and ex-OpenAI researchers Josh Tobin, Jeff Clune, and Tim Shi.
key_facts.excerpt: The four-month-old London-incorporated startup names co-founders from Google DeepMind and OpenAI, including Berlin-born UCL professor Tim Rocktäschel and former OpenAI researchers Josh Tobin, Jeff Clune, and Tim Shi... Socher said the startup has about 20 staff.

key_facts.fact: The earlier Series A reported in April was at least $500M led by GV with Nvidia participating, at a $4B pre-money valuation; the deal was oversubscribed.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's venture arm GV led the round with backing from Nvidia, securing at least $500 million at a $4 billion pre-money valuation, the Financial Times reported. The round was oversubscribed and could eventually reach $1 billion.

key_facts.fact: The company's stated goal is to automate the entire AI development pipeline, including evaluation, data selection, training, post-training, and research direction, building so-called recursively self-improving systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Richard Socher told Implicator.ai the company has already hit undisclosed technical milestones and aims to automate the entire AI development pipeline, from evaluation through research direction.

stories.headline: Foxconn Confirms North America Factory Cyberattack; Nitrogen Claims 8TB Stolen

key_facts.fact: Foxconn confirmed Tuesday that some of its North American factories suffered a cyberattack and that affected plants are 'currently resuming normal production' after outages.
key_facts.excerpt: 'Some of Foxconn's factories in North America suffered a cyberattack. The cybersecurity team immediately activated the response mechanism and implemented multiple operational measures to ensure the continuity of production and delivery. The affected factories are currently resuming normal production,' Foxconn said.

key_facts.fact: Ransomware group Nitrogen claimed responsibility, posting that it stole 8 terabytes of data — roughly 11 million files — including schematics and project details from Dell, Google, Apple, AMD, Intel, and Nvidia.
key_facts.excerpt: A ransomware group is attempting to extort the electronics manufacturing giant Foxconn, claiming that it stole 8 terabytes of data from the company, including schematics and project details from customers including Dell, Google, Apple, and Nvidia.

key_facts.fact: The breach centered on Foxconn's Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin facility — a hub for AI server production — where Wi-Fi was cut off May 1 and core plant infrastructure was disrupted; production was halted for roughly a week before resuming May 12.
key_facts.excerpt: On May 11, 2026, the Nitrogen ransomware group claimed to have stolen 8 terabytes of data from Foxconn's Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin facility — over 11 million files including assembly instructions, data center topology diagrams for Google and Intel, and hardware schematics linked to Apple, NVIDIA, and Dell... Outage: Multi-day IT outage began May 1, halting production for nearly a week.

key_facts.fact: Allegedly stolen materials include data center network topology diagrams for Google and Intel — architectural maps of live infrastructure with supply chain intelligence implications.
key_facts.excerpt: The Nitrogen ransomware claim against Foxconn Wisconsin is a supply chain intelligence story, not just a ransomware story. The alleged theft of data center network topology diagrams — architectural maps of live infrastructure — could have consequences far beyond Foxconn itself.
